hebrewText: יְהוָ֤ה נְחֵ֬/נִי בְ/צִדְקָתֶ֗/ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑/י הושר הַיְשַׁ֖ר לְ/פָנַ֣/י דַּרְכֶּֽ/ךָ

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)
tokens.kjv: bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.

tokens.bdb: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
tokens.kjv: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), [phrase] lest, that, to.

tokens.bdb: to be hostile (only active participle an opponent)
to be straight or even; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make) right, pleasant, prosperous
tokens.kjv: direct, fit, seem good (meet), [phrase] please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly).
